package filestorage

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestUploadStarterArchiveCreatesTemporaryFileWithTTL(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.URL.Path != "/internal/v1/files/upload" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: %s %s", r.Method, r.URL.Path)
		}
		if err := r.ParseMultipartForm(1 << 20); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse multipart form: %v", err)
		}
		for field, expected := range map[string]string{
			"file_kind":      "PREVIEW_ENV_ARCHIVE",
			"owner_id":       "task-id",
			"is_archive":     "true",
			"archive_format": "zip",
			"is_temp":        "true",
			"ttl_minutes":    "60",
		} {
			if actual := r.FormValue(field); actual != expected {
				t.Errorf("%s=%q, want %q", field, actual, expected)
			}
		}
		file, header, err := r.FormFile("file")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read uploaded file: %v", err)
		}
		defer func() {
			_ = file.Close()
		}()
		payload, err := io.ReadAll(file)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read uploaded payload: %v", err)
		}
		if header.Filename != "starter.zip" || string(payload) != "archive" {
			t.Errorf("unexpected upload: filename=%q payload=%q", header.Filename, payload)
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"file-id"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	fileID, err := client.UploadStarterArchive(context.Background(), "task-id", "starter.zip", []byte("archive"))

	if err != nil || fileID != "file-id" {
		t.Fatalf("upload result: id=%q err=%v", fileID, err)
	}
}

func TestActivateStarterArchiveConfirmsPermanentFile(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.URL.Path != "/internal/v1/files/file-id/activate" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: %s %s", r.Method, r.URL.Path)
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"file":{"ID":"file-id","IsTemp":false,"ExpiresAt":null},"activated":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL + "/api/v1", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if err := client.ActivateStarterArchive(context.Background(), "file-id"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("activate failed: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestActivateStarterArchiveReturnsFileStorageError(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		http.Error(w, "activation failed", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if err := client.ActivateStarterArchive(context.Background(), "file-id"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("filestorage error was accepted")
	}
}
